up: Show the exact activity values and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649961. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard relation, standard value, and standard units.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649961' AND a.standard_relation IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
